description: Traffic Waze - Alertes en temps réel is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data de la Ville de Fleury-sur-Orne, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Waze. Données de circulation Waze mises à jour toutes les 2 minutes sur les alertes à Fleury-sur-Orne. Coverage: Fleury-sur-Orne. The portal files it under Mobilités, Transports, Déplacements. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-fleurysurorne-fr-portal.
